in_marathi.name: Avesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Winds
in_marathi.long_meaning: Avesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Avesh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vayu', meaning 'wind'. In Hindu mythology, Avesh is the god of wind and is often depicted riding a chariot drawn by horses or elephants. He is also known as the god of knowledge and is believed to bring wisdom and clarity to those who seek it.
